page.notes: The Greek phrase ἀκαίρως εὐκαίρως (2 Tim. 4:2) is set in italic type; the accents and the second word are uncertain, so the whole phrase is marked [?]. "speciofo" and "mistio" are copied as printed. The Latin uses long-s forms throughout, which have been written as plain s. No printing error was corrected.
